verdict.rationale: Apify is a web-scraping and crawling platform, so honoring robots.txt and per-site rate limits is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions robots.txt handling or automatic throttling of requests to target sites. The related items cover IP rotation to avoid blocking, session pools, a maxCrawlPages cap and API-client retries, and none of these is crawl-politeness configuration.
